senses.zh_definition: 待辨义的字母序列“fu”；现有资料不足以确定其独立马来语词义。
senses.en_definition: The unresolved token 'fu'; the supplied evidence does not establish an independent Malay lexical meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tulisan 'fu' yang makna dan fungsi leksikalnya belum dapat ditentukan daripada maklumat yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 本项是元语言说明，不是已确认的独立词义；noun 仅表示把该字母序列当作讨论对象。DBP 收录 kung fu，但不能据此把独立出现的 fu 直接释为“功夫”。也不能在没有汉字和语境时认定它表示“福”或某个姓氏。status 的 official 值仅按所要求的输出模板保留，不表示此词元已获 DBP 认证。以下搭配是编辑讨论用语，不宣称为高频词汇搭配。参考：[DBP：kung fu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kung+fu)。

etymology.historical_story: No reliable origin story can yet be assigned to this isolated token. DBP records kung fu as a complete expression, but that does not establish the identity of fu in this packet. A name, an abbreviation, and a fragment of a longer expression would require different histories. Recovering the original sentence must therefore precede etymological interpretation. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kung+fu).
